findings.text: follow-on: the finished run added for the re-arming session (r-late-review) is never offered by the head pass (offered == ["r-scoring"]) nor by any of the four recorded controls (negative-control.log offers only r-attended-review), because the filterless reflex resolves the sweeping process's own registered session at reckon/crew/recovery_review_acceptance.py:396 and never reaches the re-arming session's runs -- so this added fixture run contributes no discrimination, and the comment at line 376 that "a pass that read no filter would offer both" misdescribes the behaviour the instrument actually shows.

item_verdicts.diff: read 666b8137..b46db0675 commit by commit; the single increment b46db0675 changes only tests/test_the_watcher_sweeps_unfollowed_sessions.py (+31/-8), adding a finished run for the re-arming session (r-late-review) and one for the attended session (r-attended-review), aging the attended one to the swept session's age, and moving the offered assertion above the launched assertion.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_the_watcher_sweeps_unfollowed_sessions.py, a head/base parity over the tests importing reckon/crew/runs.py, and a ruff delta on the changed Python files; the manifest records the gate at gate/watcher-sweep-committed.log (2 passed, EXIT=0, revision b46db0675) and both parity arms, but the base arm's chunk_08 is a collection abort recorded as a clean pass (gate/base-suite-third.txt:13), so the parity instrument overstates its coverage.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is that the project watcher sweep each session that has had no live follower for ten minutes, passing that session explicitly; the increment this review is scoped to is b46db0675, a test-only commit, and it strengthens the fixture that pins the sweep's review pass to the session it swept (tests/test_the_watcher_sweeps_unfollowed_sessions.py:281-296), leaving the production behaviour the goal names untouched.
item_verdicts.manifest: read manifest.md; status complete at head b46db0675, it records the gate command and its 2-passed / EXIT=0 result, four negative controls with their logs, both parity arms and the ruff delta, and it discloses that the node's declared negative control was replaced.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared write paths are reckon/crew/runs.py, tests/test_the_watcher_sweeps_unfollowed_sessions.py, docs/evidence/fragments/the-monitor-shows-the-work-it-watches/the-watcher-sweeps-unfollowed-sessions.html and docs/figures/the-monitor-shows-the-work-it-watches/the-watcher-sweeps-unfollowed-sessions; the increment touches only the test file, which is inside them.

justifications.reuse: the increment reuses the shared _scoring_pointer fixture (tests/test_review_lane_follows_its_run.py) and _age_run (tests/test_the_watcher_sweeps_unfollowed_sessions.py:99) rather than adding a second way to compose a review-ready run.
